text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Groove-saaan! Listen, listen! That 
flower... It bloomed beautifully~!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...! I see, finally! Well done, Fine!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
No, it's all thanks to you, Groove-san! 
Because...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Right after sprouting, they're so 
delicate that just touching them can make 
them wither. And once they grow... stem 
cuttings...?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Are those... flower seeds?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. My big sister sent it to me! I'm 
looking up how to care for it right now, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It says here it's for advanced growers! 
Guess I'll just have to do my best while 
looking things up~.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Fool. Someone with expertise is right here 
before you. So rely on me. Do not hold 
back if it is something you are not 
accustomed to.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
“Still, are you sure? Groove-san, you're 
plenty busy as it is.”

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Listen, don't shoulder it all by yourself. 
...If a seed brought from a distant 
foreign land cannot sprout, it would 
surely be a pity.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's all because you lent a hand, 
Groove-san, that they grew this much! 
You're truly a savior to both the flowers 
and me!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I just sent a picture to my sister saying, 
"It bloomed without any trouble!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ah, a phone call from Onee-sama!

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
"‘Greetings, fair princess. 
Congratulations, it seems you have bloomed 
a lovely flower befitting your grace!’"

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, who's that at the edge of the 
screen...?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...T-Thank you for your continued support.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text: "...Good grief."

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
"‘My heart's own "Empress"! If it isn't 
you, with those unforgettable crimson 
eyes! Sending those flower seeds was the 
right choice after all!’"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"What do you mean, 'as expected'...? Don't 
tell me you anticipated this would 
happen...?!"

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
"If she sees the seeds of a flower that's 
difficult to cultivate, the Goddess of 
Flowers will surely smile upon my little 
sister. So I decided to take a gamble on 
that chance."

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
"‘I also wish for an opportunity to speak 
directly. Shall I simply come visit you 
myself? Bearing a bouquet of affection, 
admiration, and burning passion—’"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Eek, I have some business to attend to, so 
next time!

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
""Ah, what a shame, she got away. If we 
were on the same turf, I'd catch her 
without fail!""

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for sending the flowers, Big 
Sister. It was a bit tough, but it turned 
out to be a good experience.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu, I simply wanted to enjoy a 
conversation with 'Her Empress Majesty.' 
You could even say I merely used you for 
that purpose."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Is that really true, I wonder? To go out 
of your way to send flowers that can't 
survive without human hands...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Say, weren't you actually giving me 
practice in "relying on someone"? Just 
like back then—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Wait, wait, Onee-sama...!

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
What is the matter, Princess? Your 
normally rosy cheeks are quite pale. You 
should head back to your room and rest.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Please, let me thank you. If you hadn't 
come to that press conference, Onee-sama, 
I think it would have gone on and on...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you. I was surprised when you 
suddenly barged in, but you came to put an 
end to this, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
I simply wanted to speak with the Princess 
as soon as possible. I shall take my leave 
for today, however.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
...Well, setting that aside. You need to 
learn to lean on those around you more, 
Fine.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, Onee-sama. I'm still not 
very good at it, but I was able to lean on 
you properly.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
"...That is splendid. But I must 
reiterate, I merely had the fortune of 
speaking with 'Her Majesty the Empress.'"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, understood. Be sure to let me thank 
you next time, Onee-sama.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, are you sure about that? I might 
actually get my hopes up, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes! Look forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "...And so, I brought it back with me!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I'm still thinking about it, but I was 
wondering if I should send some 
refreshments over."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Is it about Groove-san after all? Or 
maybe... do you have any good ideas?
choice_data_list:
Maybe a dish the two of you cooked 
together?

Enclose a challenge letter for a future 
race.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I see, thank you! I'll go learn how to 
cook from Groove-san!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Can we ship dishes by jet plane, I 
wonder... Anyway, let's go!

...Air Groove seemed like she'd have her 
hands full, but I was glad to hear such a 
heartwarming story about the bond between 
sisters.

I told them that leveraging our experience 
here to promise running together in the 
future might bring them joy...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...! So it's more like I should be 
thanking you, right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That sounds fun! It might be the best way 
to thank Onee-sama for supporting my study 
abroad!

Two Umamusume running in distant lands, 
bound by a powerful bond. I found myself 
wishing to see that dream showdown, if at 
all possible...
